purpose: Separate client TTFT, client first-to-last text TPOT, engine IPC token-arrival TPOT, and engine reciprocal throughput. Preserve burst timing without interpolation.
observer: latency_server.py wraps only stdin/stdout streams; inference and frontend source unchanged
limits: Client SSE delta need not equal one token. IPC timestamps mark Python reader arrival, not GPU or engine producer time. Existing historic SSE records lack arrivals and cannot recover ITL distribution.
